prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1400; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear bumper cover cracked across the center with the left tail lamp assembly broken and the trunk lid edge creased. Damage pattern is consistent with the reported rear impact, and no prior damage to the vehicle is known to us. Repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp, straightening the trunk lid, and refinishing the affected panels. Labor hours submitted fit the scope of this damage. Two similar charges posted on the same day are currently under review before the estimate is finalized.
